label: KGhost
description: Race against a ghost on your Karoo: a fixed-pace Ghost Pace or your own past self on a route, stitched into one continuous ghost. Shows the live time/distance gap on graphical and numeric data fields and draws the ghost's position on the map. Records each ride automatically and can import GPX/FIT ghosts dropped in /sdcard/KGhost. Keeps estimating during GPS dropouts. Beta version, use with care.
releaseNotes: Much faster history import for large libraries (already-imported rides are skipped). Recorded-track count now refreshes after a reinstall once all-files access is granted. Storage-permission warning is now shown on the main screen with an occasional in-ride reminder. Improve data parsing. Improve ghost behaviour. Fix re-routing. Fix average mode (cool down case). Fix ghost starting ahead when Karoo map-matches wrong position before GPS locks.
